title: 2102 Ocelot Cir
description:
Custom-built and thoughtfully updated, this stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bath home in Harker Heights is the one you've been waiting for.
From the moment you arrive, you'll sense that this home was built with intention and maintained with pride. Step inside and be greeted by rich hardwood and marble floors that flow throughout, giving every room a warm yet elevated feel. The layout is as functional as it is beautiful — with a dedicated office for those work-from-home days, a formal dining room made for gathering, and a sitting room perfect for quiet mornings or relaxed evenings with family.
The big-ticket updates are already done for you. New dual-pane windows bring in natural light while keeping your energy bills in check. The roof is only 4 years young, gutters are in place, and everything is move-in ready — so you can focus on living, not renovating.
But the crown jewel of this property? Step outside into a garden that will truly steal your heart. This isn't just a backyard — it's a retreat. Lush, lovingly maintained, and bursting with life, the garden features a pear tree, a kumquat tree, and a gorgeous fountain that makes every afternoon feel like a vacation. Whether you're sipping your morning coffee or hosting friends on a warm Texas evening, this outdoor space will become your favorite room in the house.
Homes like this — custom-built, beautifully updated, and full of character — don't come along often. Come see 2102 Ocelot Circle for yourself. You're going to fall in love.
